WITH filtered_races AS (
  SELECT r.circuitId, c.country
  FROM races r
  INNER JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  WHERE r.date >= '1978-03-04' AND r.date <= '2003-03-09'
),
circuit_counts AS (
  SELECT circuitId, country, COUNT(*) as race_count
  FROM filtered_races
  GROUP BY circuitId, country
),
country_averages AS (
  SELECT country, AVG(race_count) as country_avg
  FROM circuit_counts
  GROUP BY country
)
SELECT 
  cc.circuitId,
  cc.country,
  cc.race_count,
  CAST(cc.race_count AS REAL) / ca.country_avg as ratio
FROM circuit_counts cc
LEFT JOIN country_averages ca ON cc.country = ca.country
ORDER BY 
  CASE WHEN ratio IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  ratio DESC
LIMIT 10;
